prompts.A: Does this chest radiograph contain lung opacity suspicious for pneumonia? Answer with exactly one label: no or yes.
prompts.L: Locate any lung opacity suspicious for pneumonia in this chest radiograph. Return only a JSON list of bounding boxes [[x1,y1,x2,y2],...], with coordinates normalized to 0–1000. Return [] when no target finding is visible.
prompts.crop: Does the currently visible image region contain lung opacity suspicious for pneumonia? Answer with exactly one label: no or yes.

auxiliary_balance: positive first, then negative, alternate; separate class queues

views.crop_bounds: floor left/top, ceil right/bottom; translate within image to preserve full target, clip only if full requested size exceeds image
views.resize: Pillow bicubic; Qwen processor historical smart resize for every view
views.control_generation: horizontal mirrored target first, then seed42 uniform integer positions; first geometrically valid candidate only

localization.coordinate_rounding: nearest integer, preserve positive width and height
localization.matching: maximize count of IoU>=.5 matches, then sum IoU, stable index tie break
localization.max_new_tokens: freeze from all training target token lengths plus EOS and 16-token margin; minimum64, round up to16
localization.invalid_output: retain patient denominator; recall/joint failure; predicted box count unknown if parse impossible

budget_policy: shared GPU-worker wall time; smoke first; M0/W parallel; M1/M2 matched parallel; third slot may evaluate completed models; reserve evaluation before branches; no automatic budget increase
test_access: sealed via DevelopmentData whitelist and filesystem audit hook
development_claim: exploratory reused development set; single training seed
